questions.q: Describe how to prepare pure, dry crystals of copper(II) sulfate from copper(II) oxide and dilute sulfuric acid. Portal response box.
questions.a: Warm acid (1); add CuO until in excess/no more dissolves (1); filter to remove excess (1); heat filtrate to evaporate some water (1); leave to cool and crystallise (1); filter and dry crystals between filter paper (1)
questions.model: Teacher writes step 1 with its reason.

questions.q: Home crystal growing (safe salt): dissolve table salt in warm tap water with an adult until no more dissolves; leave on a saucer. Describe what you see after 3 days.
questions.a: Cubic salt crystals form as water evaporates

questions.q: Calculate the maximum mass of CuSO₄ from 4.0 g CuO (Mr CuO 79.5, CuSO₄ 159.5).
Explain why the solution is not heated to dryness.
questions.a: Crystals would lose their water of crystallisation/decompose (1); and could spit; slow cooling gives larger, purer crystals (1)
questions.model: Heating to dryness drives off water of crystallisation and makes powder, not crystals. Stop at saturation and let it cool.
